headline: Policy Subcommittee reviews new Classroom Observation Policy, facility use for new high school, and middle school name update in policy #8335.
summary: The subcommittee will discuss a new proposed Classroom Observation Policy, revisions to Student Visitation Policy #6105, use of the new South Kingstown High School and Curtis Corner Athletic Complex under Policy #9205, and updating Middle School Access to Excellence Policy #8335 to reference Broad Rock Middle School instead of Curtis Corner Middle School.
items: Discuss new proposed Classroom Observation Policy
Discuss possible revisions to Student Visitation Policy #6105 related to Classroom Observation Policy
Discuss Use of Facilities Policy #9205 regarding use of the new South Kingstown High School and Curtis Corner Athletic Complex
Discuss updating Middle School Access to Excellence Policy #8335 to change references from Curtis Corner Middle School to Broad Rock Middle School
Note related policy: Access to Excellence Chemical Health Policy #8330
Review upcoming policies, meetings, and tasks including administrative requests, proposed agenda items, and review of action items
location: Administration Building Conference Room, 307 Curtis Corner Rd, Wakefield, Rhode Island
